title: On Type Deception in Linear-Quadratic Differential Games
summary: We consider two-player linear-quadratic differential games of incomplete information, in which one player has a private type initially unknown to the other. The typed player has incentive to conceal their type, while the uninformed player has the potential to infer it during play. Any ex-ante equilibrium in this setting will decompose into a deceptive, pooling phase, and a complete-information, revelatory phase.
